chapter.heading: Job 5
chapter.v: the holy ones will you turn?
and jealousy slays the simple.
but suddenly I cursed his dwelling.
and there is no one to deliver them.
and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
nor does trouble sprout from the ground,
as the sparks fly upward.
and to God would I commit my cause,
marvelous things without number:
and sends waters on the fields;
and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
so that their hands achieve no success.
and the schemes of the wily are brought to a quick end.
grope at noonday as in the night.
and from the hand of the mighty.
injustice shuts her mouth.
Almighty.
shatters, but his hands heal.
evil shall touch you.
and in war from the power of the sword.
and shall not fear destruction when it comes.
the beasts of the earth.
and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.
and you shall inspect your fold and miss nothing.
the grass of the earth.
like a sheaf gathered up in its season.
Hear, and know it for your good.”

footnotes.footnote: 5:5 The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain
5:5 Aquila, Symmachus, Syriac, Vulgate; Hebrew could be read as *and the snare pants*
